tests.action: Sign in as Teacher with valid credentials and complete any required baseline survey.
tests.expected: The teacher reaches Home or the first permitted page; teacher navigation is shown and admin navigation is hidden.

tests.action: Review the dashboard, open the lesson-plan generator, inspect recent plans, change the analytics period, and move between calendar months.
tests.expected: Dashboard data loads; each action updates the correct view or opens the correct route without errors.

tests.action: View the profile, upload and remove a profile image, edit permitted class/resource details, and save.
tests.expected: Read-only identity fields remain protected; editable changes save and remain after reload; confirmation dialogs work for removals.

tests.action: Search and filter saved content, open a lesson plan or resource, and use the empty-state Generate action when no records exist.
tests.expected: Search/filter results update correctly; content cards open the matching view; the empty state is clear and actionable.

tests.action: Select board, grade, subject, chapter, topic, and learning outcome, then generate a lesson plan.
tests.expected: Required fields are enforced; valid selections enable generation; a generated lesson plan is created and its status is visible.

tests.action: Select the required source fields and generate a lesson resource with activities, scenarios, questions, and comprehension levels.
tests.expected: The resource is generated with the requested sections and appears in the content list.

tests.action: Edit a generated lesson plan or resource, save changes, add or remove media, and navigate away with unsaved changes.
tests.expected: Edits persist after save; media actions work; the draft guard warns before discarding unsaved changes.

tests.action: Open a saved lesson plan or resource, view its documents/resources, download an available file, and delete it after confirmation.
tests.expected: The selected content opens; available downloads start; cancellation preserves the record and confirmed deletion removes it from the list.

tests.action: Create a question paper by selecting board, grade, subject, source, chapter, sub-topic when required, exam name, marks, and template steps; preview and submit.
tests.expected: Dependent selections reset correctly; validation blocks incomplete input; preview has no duplicate sections; submission creates a paper.

tests.action: Open a saved question paper, inspect sections and questions, download it, and submit feedback rating.
tests.expected: The paper renders its available content; download works; feedback selection saves without an error.

tests.action: Switch between My Schedules and Others' Schedules, move the calendar view, open an event, and view its lesson plan or details.
tests.expected: The correct schedule set is displayed; calendar navigation works; event actions open the matching details.

tests.action: Create a schedule entry, edit it, cancel the edit, and delete an entry after confirmation.
tests.expected: Valid schedule data is saved; cancellation leaves the entry unchanged; confirmed deletion removes it.

tests.action: Open Help and FAQ, inspect the available video guides, and play an embedded guide.
tests.expected: Help content and FAQ are reachable; video iframes render; no broken or empty support page is shown.

tests.action: Navigate directly to admin dashboard, school, teacher, staff, role, content-activity, training, and audit-log routes as Teacher.
tests.expected: Each route is blocked or redirected because the Teacher lacks the required permission.

tests.action: Open the profile menu and log out.
tests.expected: The logout confirmation appears; confirmation ends the session and protected routes return to sign-in.

tests.action: Sign in as Power Teacher with valid credentials and complete any required baseline survey.
tests.expected: The Power Teacher reaches the teacher workspace and sees the teacher navigation plus Generation Status and Chatbot.

tests.action: Review generation cards, status badges, empty state, and open an active, failed, draft, or completed item when available.
tests.expected: Statuses use the correct state labels; available actions open progress, draft, or completed content; empty state renders cleanly.

tests.action: Send a valid chat message, copy a response, open sample instructions, restart the chat, and try to send an empty message.
tests.expected: A valid message receives a response; copy and sample actions work; restart clears the conversation; empty input is rejected.

tests.action: Verify that presentation generation is excluded from this UAT execution.
tests.expected: No presentation-generation action is executed or used as an acceptance criterion.

tests.action: Navigate directly to an admin-only route as Power Teacher.
tests.expected: The route is blocked or redirected because Power Teacher has no admin-management permissions.

tests.action: Sign in as Admin with valid credentials and open the landing page.
tests.expected: The Admin reaches the permitted admin workspace; analytics, school, teacher, staff, role, training, content activity, audit, profile, help, and FAQ navigation is available according to permissions.

tests.action: Open the analytics dashboard and inspect loading, error, dashboard, and scoped-data states.
tests.expected: Analytics loads for the Admin scope; loading and error states are clear; displayed data matches the assigned scope.

tests.action: List schools, search/filter and paginate, export the list, open a school, and use the more-options menu.
tests.expected: The list, filters, pagination, and export work; school details open; only permitted actions are enabled.

tests.action: Create a school with valid details, facilities, holidays, classes, subjects, and resources; submit invalid and valid forms.
tests.expected: Validation identifies missing or invalid fields; valid data creates the school; the new school appears in the list.

tests.action: Edit a school, add and remove facilities or holidays, save, and deactivate or reactivate a school after confirmation.
tests.expected: Edits persist; add/remove controls update the form; lifecycle actions require confirmation and update the school status.

tests.action: List teachers, search/filter and paginate, open a teacher, edit permitted fields, and save.
tests.expected: Teacher records load within scope; filters and pagination work; permitted edits persist; out-of-scope records are not exposed.

tests.action: Create a teacher with valid identity, school, profile, and role data, then submit invalid and valid forms.
tests.expected: Validation blocks incomplete data; a valid teacher is created with the selected role and school assignment.

tests.action: Use teacher bulk import, export, deactivate, and reactivate actions with valid and invalid files or records.
tests.expected: Valid import creates records; invalid input reports the failure; export downloads scoped records; lifecycle actions update status after confirmation.

tests.action: List staff, search/filter and paginate, open a staff record, create or edit staff, and change lifecycle status.
tests.expected: Staff records and forms use the staff fields; valid changes persist; unauthorized actions are disabled or rejected.

tests.action: View roles and permissions, search permissions, view assigned users, create a role, edit a non-system role, and attempt to delete a system or assigned role.
tests.expected: Role and permission data loads; assigned users can be viewed; valid role changes persist; system roles and roles with users cannot be deleted.

tests.action: Search content history, apply state, zone, district, block, and school filters, open a completed lesson activity, and export results.
tests.expected: Filters update the activity list; completed content opens the matching lesson-plan activity; export downloads the scoped report.

tests.action: List training batches, inspect statistics, search available teachers, open a batch, and use the participant panel.
tests.expected: Batch data and statistics load; teacher search and pagination work; batch details and participant controls match the Admin scope.

tests.action: Create a training batch with valid details and submit invalid and valid forms.
tests.expected: Validation blocks incomplete data; valid submission creates a batch and returns to the batch list.

tests.action: Assign and remove teachers, mark attendance, upload or remove batch media, save and submit the batch, and download attendance and teacher reports.
tests.expected: Assignments and attendance persist; media controls work; submitted-batch restrictions are enforced; reports download with the correct records.

tests.action: Review audit entries, refresh the list, paginate, and open available log details or downloads.
tests.expected: Audit entries load; refresh and pagination work; in-progress, failed, and completed log states are clear; available logs can be downloaded.

tests.action: View and update the Admin profile where editing is permitted, then verify the saved values after reload.
tests.expected: The Admin can view the profile; permitted changes persist; protected identity fields remain read-only.

tests.action: Navigate directly to teacher-only chat, content-generation, question-paper-generation, and schedule routes as Admin.
tests.expected: Routes requiring teacher-only permissions are blocked or redirected; Admin-only routes remain available.

tests.action: Open the profile menu and log out.
tests.expected: The logout confirmation appears; confirmation ends the session and protected routes return to sign-in.

tests.action: For each role, open a permitted route, then open a route requiring a permission absent from that role by direct URL.
tests.expected: The permission guard enforces the same access decision for direct URLs as for sidebar links; unauthorized routes do not render protected data.

tests.action: Compare Teacher, Power Teacher, and Admin sidebars after sign-in and after a page reload.
tests.expected: Navigation matches the role permissions; Power Teacher adds only its teacher extensions; Admin does not receive teacher-only generation controls.

tests.action: Log out, then attempt to revisit the last protected URL and use the browser back action.
tests.expected: The protected page is not accessible without a valid session; the user is redirected to sign-in.
